lines: Bliss blinkered here in all three spheres — whose droplet?
To that God, the bliss-sea, I lower my head.
sanskrit_cite: trailokye 'py atra yo yāvān ānandaḥ kaścid īkṣyate sa bindur yasya taṃ vande devam ānandasāgaram

lines: Blessed Brahmā's brood, prattle past, who babble glad-drunk —
'Śiva, hail, hail.'
sanskrit_cite: aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ

lines: To the hungerless apportioner of hungers numberless,
the world's unwitnessed dawn-dweller and devourer — Bhava, take hail of me.
sanskrit_cite: niṣkāmāyāpi kāmānām anantānāṃ vidhāyine anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te

lines: The eldest root-stock of the triple morrow we extol —
what meed craves he, the all-accomplished?
sanskrit_cite: stumas tribhuvanārambhamūlaprakṛtim īśvaram lipseran nopakāraṃ ke yataḥ sampūrṇadharmaṇaḥ

lines: Mid straits though straitened, slimed with folly's spate —
call him to mind, and wits grow pellucid: Śiva we lift.
sanskrit_cite: mahatsv apy arthakṛcchreṣu mohaughamalinīkṛtāḥ smṛte yasmin prasīdanti matayas taṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ

lines: Lord, from thee solely, the sovran vigour springs uncloven —
at thy beck tri-worlds set and sink.
sanskrit_cite: prabho bhavata eveha prabhuśaktir abhaṅgurā yadicchayā pratāyete trailokyasya layodayau

lines: Foul aimed Godward ferments fine; fine elsewhere —
for elsewhere thou standest not so: hail, ho!
sanskrit_cite: kukarmāpi yam uddiśya devaṃ syāt sukṛtaṃ param sukṛtasyāpi saukṛtyaṃ yato 'nyatra na so 'si bhoḥ

lines: 'Fisted, thou art grasped; eyed, thou art spied — whither from us?'
so wine-mad on love-sap, the blest course the Thicket-locked.
sanskrit_cite: eṣa muṣṭyā gṛhīto 'si dṛṣṭa eṣa kva yāsi naḥ iti bhaktirasādhmātā dhanyā dhāvanti dhūrjaṭim

lines: Thee hymn we — sung in verse and chant, from splendour, past splendour, uttermost —
whose text-fleshed truth abides — ah, sombre-fair.
sanskrit_cite: stumas tvām ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śukrataḥ parataḥ param yasya vedātmikājñeyam aho gambhīrasundarī

lines: Edict thou, alpha, and omega of the cosmos, High Lord —
the code-files filed from thee: unfiled from thee, whence filed?
sanskrit_cite: vidhir ādis tathānto 'si viśvasya parameśvara dharmagrāmaḥ pravṛtto yas tvatto na sa kuto bhavet
